## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] A rule change includes a test that fires it and a test that a nearby good prompt does not
- [ ] The result stays deterministic: no randomness, no model calls, no network access
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry if user-visible behavior changed
